run_contributor_audit: run the contributor audit script to find contributors missing from release notes since a given tag
review_collect_commit_authors: review the collect_commit_authors function that scans git commit authors within a tag range
review_collect_co_authors: review the collect_co_authors function that extracts contributors from Co-authored-by trailers in commit messages
review_collect_salvaged_contributors: review the collect_salvaged_contributors function that scans merged PR bodies for salvage and cherry-pick attribution
review_check_release_file: review the check_release_file function that compares contributors against a release notes file to find missing mentions
